Remove old wrist cuffs, apron, skirt and tights; forearms and knees uncovered. Keep all sixteen original poses in order: standing, talking, thinking, crouching, jumping, landing, knees hugged, sleeping, curled on side, stacking blocks in three phases, lifted with hands up in two phases, flinching, shrugging. Retain original natural adult head/body proportions, long thighs/shins and exact folded-leg skeleton. Preserve colored blocks and hand contact. Do not stand up seated/lying poses. This is the same character in new clothes, never a new shorter or chubbier character. Original per-pose scale differences remain exactly as source for later shared animation calibration. Transparent alpha outside figures and actual props, not a painted background, no glow or new shadows.
